_doc: Storyboard v2 (source of truth). Shots are anchored to a sung word (anchor.word inside anchor.line, anchor.occ-th occurrence of that line in the song, 1-based), snapped to the beat grid (snap: downbeat|beat|none, plus offset_beats). 't' is the approximate time (s) measured by Whisper on the final WAV; it is only a fallback when the anchor cannot be resolved. anchor.word null = use 't' (instrumental passages). Each shot lasts until the next shot starts. clawd = action id from docs/STORYBOARD.md (A1-A13). Text fields are Chinese (for Tim); ids and anchors are machine-readable.

shots.visual: 拉到最远才看出来：这些设备排成了一个 16×5 的巨大 Clawd，每台设备就是一个像素。
设备一台台熄灭，回到开头那个编辑器。

片尾字幕：歌名 Works on My Machine；「每一帧都由代码画出」；制作者。随音乐渐弱淡出。
